name: Mang Jerry
dialogues: Hey Kiko! Wake me up with a hot coffee and some warm pandesal bread before I line up at the jeepney terminal. Here is a 20-peso bill!
Kiko, I would like 1 Kopiko coffee and 1 order of Pandesal bread. I am paying with a ₱20 bill.
Kopiko Coffee: 1 (₱12), Pandesal: 1 (₱6). Total: ₱18. Paid: ₱20 (Change: ₱2).
specialTrait: Lola Carmen's daily regular. Early riser before terminal queue.
storyNotes: If you open early and count change accurately, you are his favorite morning stop.

name: Ate Susan
dialogues: Good morning, Kiko! Give me two shampoo sachets and a bar of bath soap. Here is a ₱100 bill, don't shortchange me!
Kiko, two Sunsilk shampoo sachets and one Safeguard bath soap. I will pay with a ₱100 bill.
Shampoo Sachet: 2 (₱16), Bath Soap: 1 (₱22). Total: ₱38. Paid: ₱100 (Change: ₱62).
specialTrait: Sharp with coins, always watching every single peso.
storyNotes: Lola Carmen's closest friend from the public vegetable market.

name: Kuya Bodjie
dialogues: Hey buddy Kiko! A cold Cobra energy drink and a pack of crackers for my construction shift. But... Friday is payday, can I put it on my tab?
Brother Kiko, one Cobra Energy Drink and one pack of SkyFlakes. Can you list this on my credit tab for now?
Cobra Drink: 1 (₱28), SkyFlakes: 1 (₱10). Total: ₱38. Requested Credit Tab: ₱38.
specialTrait: Hardworking laborer, short on cash before payday.
storyNotes: Working on the barangay bridge project. Always settles debt on salary day.

name: Jun-Jun
dialogues: Kuya Kiko! One pack of chips and sweet candy before the morning bell! My mom gave me a crisp ₱500 bill, do you have change for this?
Kuya Kiko, please give me one Chippy BBQ chips and one Choc-Nut candy. I only have a five-hundred peso bill (₱500).
Chippy: 1 (₱15), Choc-Nut: 1 (₱3). Total: ₱18. Paid: ₱500 (Change: ₱482).
specialTrait: THE CHANGE CRISIS! Hands over a ₱500 bill for an ₱18 purchase.
storyNotes: If short on coins, offer him candy as change (Sukling Kendi) or ask for smaller bills!

name: Teacher Fe
dialogues: Good morning, Kiko! I need a hot coffee and clean crackers for our faculty meeting. Here is an exact fifty-peso bill.
Good morning! One Kopiko 3-in-1 coffee and one SkyFlakes crackers pack, please. I am paying with ₱50.
Kopiko Coffee: 1 (₱12), SkyFlakes: 1 (₱10). Total: ₱22. Paid: ₱50 (Change: ₱28).
specialTrait: Provides reading tips, grammar hints, and functional literacy feedback.
storyNotes: Kiko's former elementary teacher. Proud to see Kiko keeping the store alive.

name: Lola Remedios
dialogues: Dear Kiko... what did I come here for again? Ah, yes! Warm chocolate to soothe my knees and a candle in case the night gets dark. Here is a fifty-peso bill...
Grandson Kiko, one Milo chocolate drink sachet and one white candle. Here is ₱50.
Milo Sachet: 1 (₱14), Candle: 1 (₱10). Total: ₱24. Paid: ₱50 (Change: ₱26).
specialTrait: Slow speaker, warm stories about old times and grandmother's memories.
storyNotes: Lola Carmen's childhood friend. Mentions hidden secrets about old barangay heirlooms.

name: Tatay Ben
dialogues: Kiko, son! It is scorching hot outside. Give me an ice-cold soda to quench this thirst. Exactly twenty-five pesos right here.
Kiko, one cold Coke Swakto. Exactly twenty-five pesos (₱25).
Coke Swakto: 1 (₱25). Total: ₱25. Paid: ₱25 (Exact Payment).
specialTrait: Always pays with exact coins. Loves a friendly afternoon chat.
storyNotes: Warns Kiko about town inspections and rival price monitoring.

name: Mang Kanor
dialogues: Heeey... *hic* Kiko my friend! Give me a pack of noodles and a can of sardines... Here is ₱100, make sure you count my change right!
Kiko, one pack of Instant Pancit Canton and one can of Sardines. Here is one hundred pesos (₱100).
Pancit Canton: 1 (₱18), Sardines: 1 (₱26). Total: ₱44. Paid: ₱100 (Change: ₱56).
specialTrait: Slurred speech comprehension puzzle. Watch for coin calculations!
storyNotes: Can make mental math errors but appreciates quick, honest service.

name: Sarah
dialogues: Kuya, please make it fast! Cobra energy drink and instant noodles. I have a graveyard call center shift at 10 PM. Here is ₱500, please hurry!
Kuya Kiko, one Cobra Energy Drink and one pack of Pancit Canton. Five hundred pesos (₱500).
Cobra: 1 (₱28), Pancit Canton: 1 (₱18). Total: ₱46. Paid: ₱500 (Change: ₱454).
specialTrait: Always in a hurry, large bills, tips well if served promptly.
storyNotes: Works graveyard shifts in an IT-BPO office. Needs quick service.

name: Aling Nena
dialogues: Kiko! How much are you selling rice for these days? Let me check your soy sauce bottle. Here is twenty pesos.
Just buying one small soy sauce bottle to check your prices. Here is ₱20.
Soy Sauce: 1 (₱12). Total: ₱12. Paid: ₱20 (Change: ₱8).
specialTrait: Rival competitor scouting Kiko's inventory and change speed.
storyNotes: Runs the store across the street. If treated with respect, she offers fair supplier trades.

name: Kapitana Helen
dialogues: Good day, Kiko! Just checking in on Lola Carmen's store. Hand me an ice-cold Coke and crackers while I inspect your permit. Here is ₱50.
Kiko, one Coke Swakto and one pack of SkyFlakes. Here is fifty pesos (₱50).
Coke: 1 (₱25), SkyFlakes: 1 (₱10). Total: ₱35. Paid: ₱50 (Change: ₱15).
specialTrait: Inspects permits and cleanliness. High rating yields barangay expansion perks!
storyNotes: Holds the official expansion permit for opening the second store.

name: Kuya Joms
dialogues: Kiko boy! I brought wholesale discounts on rice and cooking oil on my sidecar! Hand me a hot coffee while I unload the sacks. Here's twenty pesos.
One Kopiko 3-in-1 coffee please, Kiko. Here is ₱20.
Kopiko Coffee: 1 (₱12). Total: ₱12. Paid: ₱20 (Change: ₱8).
specialTrait: Delivers bulk inventory and market price intelligence.
storyNotes: Always warns about coming typhoons, shortages, and wholesale deals.
